info.name: Garuda NDPS TPT API
info.description: API testing collection for the Garuda NDPS & Seizure Tracking Platform backend services. Organize API endpoints for Auth, Offenders, Cases, Vehicles, Enforcement, Surveillance, Finance, and Analytics.

item.name: 01. Authentication
item.description: Endpoints for user login, token refresh, logout, and checking current user info.

request.description: Authenticate user and set Access & Refresh Tokens. Also stores the token in the 'authToken' environment variable.

exec: console.log("Auth token saved to environment successfully.");

request.description: Obtains a new access token using a valid refresh token.
Retrieves details of the currently logged-in user.
Logs out the current session.

item.name: 02. Dashboard
item.description: KPIs and summary data for landing page/dashboard.

request.description: Retrieves overview stats, charts, and trends for NDPS enforcement.

item.name: 06. Deletion Workflow
item.description: Multistep deletion approval logs (SI/CI -> SHO -> SDPO -> SP). Only SP executes actual deletion.

request.description: Get all pending deletion requests.
Flag a record as ready for deletion (CI/SI edit level).
SHO escalates flagged record for SDPO review.
SDPO officially requests deletion of the record from SP.
SP approves the request.
SP triggers final physical database deletion.
Reject the deletion request at any level.

request.description: Get list of edit requests.
